title: Members
description: Invite the Marketing team, approve join requests, set or remove the Marketing role, and choose which projects each person can see.
emptyHint: Members and invites will show up here.

invites.title: Invite Marketing
invites.hint: Click Invite Marketing, pick the projects the invited person will see, then create the link. They open it, sign up or sign in and send a join request; once you approve, they get the chosen projects right away.
invites.linkHint: Shown only once, copy it and send it to the invited person.
invites.projectsTitle: Projects the invited person will see
invites.projectsHint: You can leave this empty and choose later in the Visible projects column.

requests.title: Pending join requests

requests.markFailedHint: This person is view-only for now. Use Set Marketing in the members list to retry.
requests.unknownInviteHint: The invite for this request was not found. If this is a Marketing guest, use Approve and set Marketing.
requests.accessFailed: Approved, but projects were not granted
requests.accessFailedHint: This person cannot see the projects chosen on the invite yet. Choose them in the Visible projects column of the members list.
